Quantinuum has set a new world record for quantum error correction, outperforming previous benchmarks by a factor of ten and positioning the company as the leader in achieving fault‑tolerant quantum computing by 2029. The breakthrough demonstrates Quantinuum’s superior hardware and software integration, enabling more reliable qubit operation at larger scales. Industry observers view this milestone as a critical step toward practical, large‑scale quantum machines and anticipate continued progress from the company across all sectors of quantum technology.
